name: Nuclear risk
value: No US–Russia limits; N Korea tests surge
summary: New START has lapsed without replacement; North Korea tests missiles; Zaporizhzhia lost off-site power 8 Nov
state: No US–Russia treaty now limits strategic nuclear forces after New START lapsed without a replacement. North Korea fired multiple missiles on 4 Nov, its fourth launch in a month (The Star), and Zaporizhzhia lost off-site power on 8 Nov before it was restored (ThePrint, Reuters). Searches on 11 Nov found no nuclear test, alert-level change or explicit threat of use.
for_you: No official body has changed its public advice. The UK government publishes preparedness guidance on its Prepare website.

sources.title: The Star — North Korea fires multiple missiles in fourth weapons launch in a month
ThePrint (Reuters) — Power restored to Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant, IAEA says

why: Nuclear use anywhere would be a civilisational shock; arms-control treaties are weaker than at any time since the 1960s.
drivers: Threats in active wars, testing, doctrine changes, arms-control collapse, proliferation.

rubric.alert: A nuclear test, changes in deployment/alert levels, or threatened use in an active conflict.
rubric.watch: Explicit threats, unusual exercises, doctrine changes, or arms-control lapses without replacement.
rubric.normal: No explicit nuclear threats or tests; arms-control dialogue active.
